title: MV Changing the appearance of the browser window

posts.body: Here is what I attached as an image. The NW game/browser window. By default, in Windows 10, it looks like a standard system window, but in Windows 7 it had a nice blue frame. In any case, which engine/browser parameter is responsible for this? Is it possible to change it so that the player can see it?

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
that is window appearance that is responsible, same if you open
a folder, it open it with that color.
